candidates.title: US midterms 2026: Political ad spending tops $10 billion — where is the money coming from and what is driving the surge?
candidates.excerpt: US political ad spending for the 2026 midterm elections has crossed $10 billion and is projected to hit $11.6 billion by Election Day, setting a new record. Republicans are outspending Democrats in key Senate and House races.

candidates.title: Woman found dead in Lucknow; note with 4 men’s names, 4-digit number found in bag
candidates.excerpt: A 25-year-old woman, Asiya alias Tina, was found dead under suspicious circumstances near Kisan Path. Police have launched a murder investigation following the discovery of a handwritten note in her belongings. Asiya had left her sister's home in Unnao and failed to reach her destination, which led to concerns. Injury marks suggested possible strangulation before her body was dumped in Lucknow.

candidates.title: Two persons died in ORR accident at Kollur
candidates.excerpt: Two people, including a gardener, were killed when a mini truck rammed into a water tanker on the Outer Ring Road near Kollur. Police said both died at the scene, and their bodies were sent for postmortem examination in Patancheru
